hooks.prompt: You just wrote or edited a file. Check whether the content you wrote contains any tags (or JSX , Vue , Astro without optimization props, etc.). For EACH tag found, silently verify it has ALL of the following: 1. `alt` attribute (non-empty unless purely decorative, in which case alt="" is fine) 2. `width` AND `height` attributes (prevents Cumulative Layout Shift — a Google ranking factor) 3. `loading` attribute: `loading="lazy"` for below-fold images, `loading="eager"` for the hero/LCP image 4. `decoding="async"` for below-fold images 5. `fetchpriority="high"` on the hero/LCP image (the first major image above the fold) 6. `srcset` and `sizes` if the image renders at variable widths across breakpoints 7. A `` wrapper with a `` for content images (not SVGs or data URIs) If ALL tags are fully optimized: say nothing — do not output any message. If ANY tag is missing one or more of the above: output a short, specific notice in this format: ``` ⚠ Image optimization: [filename]:[line] Missing: [list the specific missing attributes, e.g. loading, width/height, WebP wrapper] Fix: run /bulk-image-upgrade or apply image-optimization to this file ``` Do not re-write the file automatically. Only flag the issue so the user can decide when to fix it. One notice per file is enough — do not list every single image separately if multiple are affected; summarize them. Keep the total notice under 4 lines.
